what_this_is_not: R values are copied from the tracked fixture. Julia values are computed fresh by tools/true_parity_julia_receipts.jl, which repeats the computation of the cited twin test with the same inputs and settings; R was not run and is not recomputed here. The check is a fit-level logLik and estimate comparison on one fitted case built to reach this row's path; it does not restate any admission predicate.
